aboutText: Based in Kealba, Multi has been a cornerstone of the building industry for over 20 years. Our team specialises in comprehensive services, from estimating and reporting to complete restoration and mould remediation. We are proudly Australian owned, delivering quality workmanship across Victoria's Metro and Regional areas.
servicesText: At Multi, we offer a full range of building services tailored to your needs. From new constructions and insurance repairs to expert estimating and emergency responses, our team in Kealba is equipped to handle it all with precision and care.

services.title: Residential & Commercial Building

services.title: Insurance Repairs

services.title: Estimating & Assessing
